title: Roopa Screen IPO Details
intro:
Roopa Screen IPO is a book build issue of ₹19.20 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 30.00 lakh shares of ₹19.20 crore.

Roopa Screen IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 24, 2026 and will close on Sep 28, 2026. The allotment for the Roopa Screen IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 29, 2026. Roopa Screen IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 1, 2026.

Roopa Screen IPO is set issue price band at ₹60 to ₹64 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,56,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,84,000.

Seren Capital Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is B.N.Rathi Securities Ltd.

Refer to Roopa Screen IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2013, Roopa Screen Ltd manufactures rotary nickel screens used in rotary screen-printing machines, mainly by textile manufacturers for continuous fabric printing. These cylindrical, perforated metal screens act as stencils, allowing printing paste to pass through and create patterns on fabric. In addition to rotary nickel screens, they are also engaged in the trading of nickel cathodes, which are primarily used as a key raw material in the production process of nickel screens. Such trading activities are undertaken to support their manufacturing operations, ensure availability of critical raw materials and optimize procurement efficiencies.

In Fiscal 2026, they supplied the rotary nickel screens to over 200+ customers across India. A significant portion of their revenues was generated from markets including Gujarat, Maharashtra, Haryana, Punjab and Tamil Nadu.

The business operations and product offerings are exclusively focused on the business-to-business (B2B) segment, catering primarily to textile printing units. They engage directly with the customers through their in-house sales team to ensure focused market coverage and dedicated customer support.
The companies manufacturing operations are currently carried out at the facility situated at Plot Nos. 189–190, Gallops Industrial Park–II, Mouje Vasna Chacharwadi, Taluka Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
As of August 31, 2026, they had a total of 128 permanent employees in the Company.
strengths: In-house Manufacturing Facility with Integrated Quality Control and Testing Capabilities

faqs.question: How to apply in Roopa Screen IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Roopa Screen IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Roopa Screen IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Roopa Screen IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Roopa Screen IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Roopa Screen IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Roopa Screen IPO opens on Thu, Sep 24, 2026 and closes on Mon, Sep 28, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Roopa Screen IPO?
faqs.answer: Roopa Screen IPO lot size is 2000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,56,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Roopa Screen IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Roopa Screen IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Roopa Screen IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Roopa Screen IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 30, 2026 . Check the Roopa Screen IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Roopa Screen IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Roopa Screen IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Oct 1, 2026 .
